hook: Constitution Day rally from *10 am* jams central Hyderabad
hook_b: Constitution Day rally from *10 am* jams central Hyderabad
tldr: A Constitution Day foot rally from Old Ambedkar Statue to Indira Gandhi Rotary on Thursday brings need-based diversions from 10 am.

beats.what: The rally starts at the Old Ambedkar Statue and goes to Indira Gandhi Rotary via Secretariat Junction and NTR Marg.
beats.why: Police will divert traffic as needed around Basheerbagh, Liberty, Secretariat, Iqbal Minar, Tank Bund and Khairatabad.
beats.care: Congestion is likely at Himayatnagar, Ravindra Bharathi, Necklace Rotary and Upper and Lower Tank Bund.

effects.label: Jams likely near Tank Bund, Khairatabad

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Hyderabad Traffic Police advised commuters to avoid the stretches, plan journeys in advance and follow personnel on the ground.

qs: How long do need-based diversions usually stay after a rally passes?

facts.t: Police listed *over 10* spots likely to see congestion, from Himayatnagar to Necklace Rotary.

viz.verdict: Commuters on the Tank Bund-Khairatabad belt are most affected.

watch: Diversions are need-based, so expect them to lift once the rally reaches Indira Gandhi Rotary.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad police announce traffic restrictions for Constitution Day rally

fact: Constitution Day foot rally from *10 am* brings diversions across central Hyderabad
twist: No parking is allowed along the route; traffic helpline is *9010203626*.
